rules.coordinates: OperationalPlan/action JSON tile is [row,col]. Runtime tile is (x=col,y=row), converted as (col,row).
rules.damage: Current formula layer: physical max(0.05A,A-D); arts max(0.05A,0.01A*(100-RES)); attack interval T0/(clamp(S,10,600)/100).
rules.economy: Natural DP and provided ledger deltas are model calculations. Refunds, skill DP and merchant upkeep are only valid with their stated evidence and conditions.
rules.range_orientation: GameData range offsets are stored for RIGHT. ApproximateRealRangeTransformer rotates them in bottom-left field coordinates.
rules.simulator_win: Current Simulator wins when no enemy leaks, the spawn schedule is exhausted, and no active enemies remain.
rules.time_sp_recovery: Current public low-rarity runtime advances time-SP by 1.0 SP/s only while inactive. SP is paused while a skill is active.
rules.unknown: Exact client timing, active roadblock ordinary-WALK navigation, target priority and unsupported effects remain UNKNOWN unless supplied evidence says otherwise.

deterministic_verifier_questions: Does the revised opening preserve Fang through the three credited payments?
Do Beagle and the earlier Midnight intercept every middle-wave runner and officer, including during the 113s handoff?
Does shared Kroos fire clear western accumulation while overlapping medics protect central blockers and Kroos?
Does eastern Steward survive and provide sufficient ranged damage and roadblock clearance?
Does the completed formation reach positive-life, zero-leak WIN after all spawns and active enemies are exhausted?
explicit_assumptions: Read-only range geometry and the conditional deployment ledger were checked; no stage simulation was run.
Frames are tactical choices under the 30 FPS current model, not exact client deadlines.
Manual skill periods include active-duration SP pauses and readiness margins.
Unsupported talents, splash geometry, refunds and targeting guarantees contribute no credited benefit.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Midnight arrives at 50s instead of 109s, and Beagle moves upstream.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.reason: A late downstream deployment cannot repair enemies that have already escaped interception.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Popukar replaces Fang while two permanent central blockers remain present.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.reason: Maintain block2 through the final formation rather than reducing the upstream replacement to block1.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Kroos faces LEFT, Noir Corne moves to [4,1], and Hibiscus moves to [4,6].
changed_conflicting_assumptions.reason: Western enemies gain ranged clearance, and Kroos receives verified healing coverage.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Ansel faces DOWN and Steward moves to the eastern platform.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.reason: Overlap healing on all blockers while assigning eastern ranged pressure and roadblock clearance explicitly.

corridor_responsibilities.owner: Beagle, Fang/Popukar and Midnight intercept the serpentine and northern routes. Kroos supports the upstream positions; both medics cover every central blocker.

Steward damages eastern ranged enemies within verified coverage. Noir Corne intercepts their western approach, with Kroos damage and Ansel healing; western clearance does not depend on Steward acquiring them.

Observe neutral passage and officer proximity. Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Assigned roadblock damage permits eventual evacuation without inventing movement commands or civilian healing.
No supplied spawn uses this route.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Temporary block2, damage and conditional automatic DP.
Central upstream fire and western exit damage; receives Hibiscus healing.
Heal Kroos and all three central blocking positions.
Permanent downstream block2, adjacent central fire and western roadblock damage.
Western block3 inside Kroos and Ansel coverage.
Heal western containment and all three central blockers.
Eastern ranged-enemy damage and eastern roadblock clearance.
Replace Fang with block2 and stronger sustained damage supporting Beagle.

formation_structure.central_sequence: Beagle [3,3] -> Fang, then Popukar [4,3] -> Midnight [5,3]; seven simultaneous blocking slots.
formation_structure.device_clearance: Midnight can attack [6,4] from 50s and Steward can attack [2,8] from 93s when each lacks a local enemy candidate. Each assigned operator covers only its assigned roadblock. No destruction deadline or navigation change is assumed.

economy.conditions: Fang must remain alive and gain uninterrupted time-SP through the three credited payments. Later Fang income and retreat refunds are excluded. Beagle becomes the upstream interceptor at 40s; overlapping healing supports Fang thereafter.

formation_structure.western_containment: Noir Corne [4,1], supported by Kroos and Ansel, intercepts all western bypasses.

formation_transitions.transition: Fang and Kroos establish interception; Hibiscus protects both before Beagle takes upstream blocking.
Add Midnight at 50s, western blocking at 64s and overlapping Ansel healing at 75s.
Add eastern Steward. Retreat Fang at 113s and deploy Popukar one frame later; Beagle and Midnight remain deployed throughout.
Retain the eight-operator formation and continue skill cadences through terminal WIN.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.invariant: WIN requires remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies.
Use only listed catalog operators with identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode true; no mode-specific reserves.
At most eight operators are deployed simultaneously; Fang is retired before Popukar deploys.
Beagle and Midnight remain deployed during the handoff; no other retreat is planned.
Do not attack or block neutral civilians, credit unsupported effects, assume target priority, or count refunds.
Continue every listed manual skill cadence only while the stage is active; 163s and the final listed frame are not termination times.

pressure_window_responsibilities.owner: Fang blocks initial officers; Kroos attacks from 11s and Hibiscus heals from 23s. Observe the first civilian without targeting it.
Beagle absorbs upstream pressure, Midnight supplies downstream capacity before the 58/64/70s runners, and western containment becomes operational.

Use all seven central blocking slots during clustered officers and runners. Midnight's 91s boost accelerates clearance. Establish eastern fire at 93s and execute the protected Fang-to-Popukar handoff before final buildup.
Maintain interception on both corridors. Beagle's 154s defense, Popukar's 154s attack and Hibiscus's 156s healing cover the final melee overlap.

Ansel's 162s boost supports western and central accumulation. Intercept the three final ranged enemies after their waits, finish both roadblocks when local enemies permit, and continue clearance and evacuation until WIN.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP; survival is a tactical dependency.

Automatic attack-SP scaled hit; no unsupported target priority or talent credit.
20s healing boosts every 51s while active stage continues.
30s defense boosts every 71s, including 154s final containment.
25s healing boosts every 61s; essential coverage uses normal range.
40s supported ATK boosts every 111s; no arts-conversion credit.
20s ATK boosts every 61s; no unsupported simultaneous multi-target damage credit.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Establish an upstream Beagle, retain Fang behind her, and deploy Midnight before the dense middle waves. Replace Fang with Popukar while both permanent blockers remain present. Turn Kroos toward central and western interception, cover her with Hibiscus, and give Ansel overlapping blocker coverage. Steward handles eastern ranged enemies and the eastern roadblock; Midnight provides western roadblock clearance.

unknown_dependencies.detail: No simulation was run for this proposal; survival, throughput and zero leaks require verification.
The first three Fang payments depend on survival under the revised opening; failure is an opening-survival failure.
Enemy competition determines available roadblock attacks. Exact destruction times and ordinary-WALK navigation effects are not established.
Kroos shares central and western targets; exact client priorities and officer choices between operators and civilians remain unresolved.
Steward has no assigned medic coverage; survival against eastern ranged pressure is unverified.

revised_stage_understanding.GameData: Serpentine melee routes, western ranged bypasses and three source civilian routes require distinct interception and clearance responsibilities.
revised_stage_understanding.current_model: Neutral civilians are excluded from ordinary targeting and blocking. Operators can damage a locally covered roadblock when no local enemy candidate is available. The verified prior run lost through interception overflow and unhealed ranged damage.
revised_stage_understanding.diagnostic_scope: The prior simulation recorded no civilian arrivals or deaths; that does not remove the civilian routes from source-stage responsibilities.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.thesis: Earlier permanent blocking, overlapping healing and shared western fire can address the verified middle-wave escapes and late western accumulation, while explicit local device coverage supplies clearance.

revised_tactical_requirements.objective: remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies
revised_tactical_requirements.operator_policy: Supplied ordinary-mode rarity 1-3 catalog only, using supplied configurations.
revised_tactical_requirements.termination: Retain interception, healing and repeated ready skills until terminal WIN.

acceptance.full_win: positive life, zero enemy leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies (including civilians), and no protected-target deaths
acceptance.perfect_goal: all protected targets safely arrive and initial life is retained
acceptance.prohibition: do not force civilians through, ignore active units, extend the 600-second cap, or assume unsupported mechanics

comparison.conclusion: V3's restructured routes regressed survival and throughput; retain successful responsibilities only when their structure remains supported, do not preserve actions by habit.
